figure_contract.core_conclusion: Compare all 25 locked models on an independent stratified-random test set after development-only 10-fold selection.

FigureS_AD.ad_definition: inside if test maximum similarity is at least the 5th percentile of development leave-one-out maxima
FigureS_AD.normalized_threshold_distance_definition: 2 * abs(predicted probability - 0.5); 0 denotes the decision boundary and 1 denotes an extreme probability
FigureS_AD.test_best_descriptive_model_role: Test-best descriptive model; reported descriptively and not used to revise model selection

supplementary_tables.table_s1_caption: Supplementary Table S1. Cross-validation and independent test-set performance of conventional machine-learning and deep-neural-network nephrotoxicity prediction models.
supplementary_tables.table_s1_note: Model selection used mean ROC-AUC across 10 development folds. CV variability is the SD across folds. Test AUC 95% CI used 2,000 stratified bootstrap replicates. Threshold metrics used p >= 0.5.
supplementary_tables.table_s2_caption: Supplementary Table S2. Hyperparameter search spaces and optimized configurations of conventional machine-learning and deep-neural-network nephrotoxicity prediction models.
supplementary_tables.table_s2_note: The search used three prespecified candidate configurations per model, rather than a Cartesian-product grid. Candidate IDs in code are zero-based.
